author: AMLB98
quote: The only good thing about this game is the NPC's. The story has no heart whatsoever. The main characters seem like they were thought up in a board room of women who don't play video games. The gun play in my opinion is worse than the previous game, just feels like any other rpg that has released in the past 8 years. Would highly discourage buying it, especially at $100. The only thing I am waiting for is the online, primarily just to see how these woke developers are going to approach that.
